title: business opportunities - u.s. embassy in estonia
paragraphs: the u.s. embassy in tallinn requires lodging services at a hotel in riga, latvia for the purposes of accommodating attendees for a training program. the program is scheduled to conduct a training course in november 2026. room requirements are estimated to be as follows: november 6-14, 2026 – 8 rooms (64 room nights) november 8-14, 2026 – 22 rooms (132 room nights) contractor shall provide a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 30 hotel rooms in tallinn, estonia. rooms shall be superior or higher rooms with single occupancy for up to thirty (30) personnel for five (5) to eight (8) consecutive nights for the above-mentioned dates. please see the rfq for full and detailed scope of work and requirements. quotations are due by october 29, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. local time (gmt+2h). direct any questions regarding this solicitation in writing to tallinngsoprocurement@state.gov by october 20 th the latest. questions must be written in english. attachment: rfq nr. 19en1027q0001 .

the u.s. embassy in tallinn requires lodging services at a hotel in riga, latvia for the purposes of accommodating attendees for a training program. the program is scheduled to conduct a training course in november 2026.

contractor shall provide a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 30 hotel rooms in tallinn, estonia. rooms shall be superior or higher rooms with single occupancy for up to thirty (30) personnel for five (5) to eight (8) consecutive nights for the above-mentioned dates.
please see the rfq for full and detailed scope of work and requirements.
quotations are due by october 29, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. local time (gmt+2h).
direct any questions regarding this solicitation in writing to tallinngsoprocurement@state.gov by october 20 th the latest.

the u.s. embassy in tallinn contracts for a variety of goods and services. the embassy is similar to other entities, but in addition to applicable local laws, we must also adhere to u.s. regulations for fair and open competition. any entity wishing to do business with the u.s. embassy tallinn under a federal acquisition regulation (far) based contract, must be registered in sam.gov . overseas federal acquisition awards up to $30,000 are granted an exception.  in order to do business with the u.s. embassy tallinn in the total value of $30,000 or above, entities will need to create a unique entity identifier in sam.gov. sam.gov is an official website of the united states government and is free to use. there is no charge to get a unique entity id, register your entity, and maintain your entity registration at sam.gov. the requirements for participating in the u.s. embassy solicitations and to be able to bid on federal contracts or other procurement opportunities include: entity registration in sam.gov compliance with the john s. mccain national defense authorization act (ndaa) the below presentation covers the essential requirements for participating in u.s. embassy solicitations and submitting a bid for your entity to be considered for a contracting opportunity. if you have additional questions, please reach out to our procurement unit at tallinngsoprocurement@state.gov . see our powerpoint for doing business with the u.s. embassy in tallinn . to see the detailed instructions for sam.gov registration process, please see the user reference guide below: sam registration for all awards user guide feel free to familiarize yourself with the u.s. government’s contracting procedures ruled by the federal acquisition regulation (far) and the department of state acquisition regulation (dosar) .
